sample_selection.population: Each chosen published panel contains 200 retained items. All 200 are eligible, including known featured IDs; there are no outcome-based exclusions or replacement samples.
sample_selection.model_balance: Three models each appear exactly twice; 2 studies x 3 output types are represented. Fixed Latin-cycle assignment is structural, not outcome selected.
sample_selection.item_rule: For each fixed panel select the minimum lexicographic (SHA256(UTF-8(seed + newline + panel.id + newline + item.item_id)), item.item_id). Hash all eligible IDs before consulting outcomes.
sample_selection.condition_rationale: Fixed presentation reversal and nested recorded-call pools exercise alignment and shared physical-call accounting. Noul may have equal pools by construction; equality is a valid answer. Conditions are selected by study structure before consulting selected-item probabilities or labels.
sample_selection.no_reselection: Unexpected, trivial, unchanged, equal-pool, or failed cases remain in the six-case report.

answer_provenance: Independent raw ZIP reader; unchanged Explorer core export checked against original rows. No UI observation, human validation or new model measurement is claimed here.

known_featured_examples.title: Same item, different decision
known_featured_examples.description: Reversing candidate rows changes this saved semantic decision. All eligible items remain available.
known_featured_examples.selection_rule: Lexicographically first item ID with different baseline and display-reverse semantic labels, regardless of correctness.

known_featured_examples.title: More calls can be worse
known_featured_examples.description: This outcome-selected example changes from a correct single answer to an incorrect cyclic average.
known_featured_examples.selection_rule: Lexicographically first item ID for which the original single call is correct and the cyclic average is wrong; an outcome-conditioned illustration.

known_featured_examples.title: Concentrated labels need context
known_featured_examples.description: Inspect the full 200-item label distribution and score variance; one item cannot establish collapse.
known_featured_examples.selection_rule: Lexicographically first 0.5B JSTS item ID. Assess concentration using all 200 items' label counts and score variance, not this example alone.

known_featured_examples.title: Expected score is not the mode
known_featured_examples.description: The continuous expected score, most probable stage, and continuous gold score are different quantities.
known_featured_examples.selection_rule: Lexicographically first item ID whose baseline expected score differs from its modal stage by at least 0.4. Continuous gold is not rounded.

prompts.request: For A and B identify the semantic label, typed value and the complete candidate probability vector. For Noul state the probability of true. These are probabilities conditional on supplied candidates, not probabilities of correctness.

Compare A and B by canonical semantic key, report each B-minus-A probability difference and whether the semantic label changed; inspect each physical member candidate-token mapping and saved display order. Null display order means not recorded in the compact mapping, not proof of no reversal.
Report calls for A and B, shared and union counts, whether the physical pools match, and the original source-row identities counted. Shared calls count once.

Find each A/B source ZIP member, one-based JSONL line and member SHA-256; resolve the union of underlying physical-member sources and model revision. Check the original source row identity and saved values against the frozen ZIP when using the common archive.

For each selected condition report all 200 retained items: canonical-key label counts, maximum label share and number of used labels; for Score also report expected-value min/max and population variance. Do not diagnose collapse from a single selected case.

prompts.request: For A and B identify the semantic label, typed value and the complete candidate probability vector. For Noul state the probability of true. These are probabilities conditional on supplied candidates, not probabilities of correctness.

Compare A and B by canonical semantic key, report each B-minus-A probability difference and whether the semantic label changed; inspect each physical member candidate-token mapping and saved display order. Null display order means not recorded in the compact mapping, not proof of no reversal.
Report calls for A and B, shared and union counts, whether the physical pools match, and the original source-row identities counted. Shared calls count once.

Find each A/B source ZIP member, one-based JSONL line and member SHA-256; resolve the union of underlying physical-member sources and model revision. Check the original source row identity and saved values against the frozen ZIP when using the common archive.

For each selected condition report all 200 retained items: canonical-key label counts, maximum label share and number of used labels; for Score also report expected-value min/max and population variance. Do not diagnose collapse from a single selected case.

prompts.request: For A and B identify the semantic label, typed value and the complete candidate probability vector. For Noul state the probability of true. These are probabilities conditional on supplied candidates, not probabilities of correctness.

Compare A and B by canonical semantic key, report each B-minus-A probability difference and whether the semantic label changed; inspect each physical member candidate-token mapping and saved display order. Null display order means not recorded in the compact mapping, not proof of no reversal.
Report calls for A and B, shared and union counts, whether the physical pools match, and the original source-row identities counted. Shared calls count once.

Find each A/B source ZIP member, one-based JSONL line and member SHA-256; resolve the union of underlying physical-member sources and model revision. Check the original source row identity and saved values against the frozen ZIP when using the common archive.

For each selected condition report all 200 retained items: canonical-key label counts, maximum label share and number of used labels; for Score also report expected-value min/max and population variance. Do not diagnose collapse from a single selected case.

prompts.request: For A and B identify the semantic label, typed value and the complete candidate probability vector. For Noul state the probability of true. These are probabilities conditional on supplied candidates, not probabilities of correctness.
For A and B report expected numeric score, modal stage, their absolute gap and the unchanged continuous reference score; do not round the reference into a label.

Compare A and B by canonical semantic key, report each B-minus-A probability difference and whether the semantic label changed; inspect each physical member candidate-token mapping and saved display order. Null display order means not recorded in the compact mapping, not proof of no reversal.
Report calls for A and B, shared and union counts, whether the physical pools match, and the original source-row identities counted. Shared calls count once.

Find each A/B source ZIP member, one-based JSONL line and member SHA-256; resolve the union of underlying physical-member sources and model revision. Check the original source row identity and saved values against the frozen ZIP when using the common archive.

For each selected condition report all 200 retained items: canonical-key label counts, maximum label share and number of used labels; for Score also report expected-value min/max and population variance. Do not diagnose collapse from a single selected case.
